```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById("projects");
  if (!root) return;
  var bands = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".pj-band"));

  /* hero jump links, one per research line */
  var nav = root.querySelector(".pj-jump");
  if (nav) bands.forEach(function (b) {
    var a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = "#" + b.id;
    var num = b.querySelector(".pj-num"), title = b.querySelector(".pj-title");
    a.innerHTML = '<span class="n"></span> ';
    a.querySelector(".n").textContent = num ? num.textContent : "";
    a.appendChild(document.createTextNode(title ? title.textContent : b.id));
    nav.appendChild(a);
  });

  /* bands and project cards fade up as they scroll into view */
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
    root.classList.add("pj-anim");
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.remove("pj-pending"); io.unobserve(en.target); }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: "0px 0px -40px 0px" });
    root.querySelectorAll(".pj-inner, .pj-card").forEach(function (el, i) {
      el.classList.add("pj-pending");
      if (el.classList.contains("pj-card")) el.style.transitionDelay = (i % 4) * 70 + "ms";
      io.observe(el);
    });
  }
})();
</script>
```
